summary.text: A Persian miniature … is a small Persian painting on paper, whether a book illustration or a separate work of art intended to be kept in an album of such works called a muraqqa.

Iran did not produce a school of history painting like India, nor of portraiture like that of the Mughals. Instead, the painters rivalled one another in virtuosity of penmanship and richness of design.
